column1: 我们优先寻找面料、成衣与配饰伙伴，尤其具备汉服/新中式相关工艺与稳定复购产能的工厂或品牌方。
column2: We prioritize fabric, garment, and accessory partners—especially factories or brands with hanfu / neo-Chinese craft and reliable reorder capacity.

column1: 品类清晰：写明形制、材质与主力 SKU，方便对口选品。
column2: Clear assortment: describe silhouettes, materials, and core SKUs so the right buyer can review.

column2: Responsive contact: complete business details shorten the first review cycle.

column1: 长期合作：优先稳定交付与可复购产能，而非一次性出货。
column2: Long-term fit: we prefer stable delivery and reorder capacity over one-off shipments.

column1: 首轮评估通常需要：营业执照或主体信息、主要品类与产能区间、代表性产品图或链接、商务联系人邮箱与电话。必要时会补充询价单、质检报告或验厂资料。
column2: Initial review usually needs entity details, category and capacity range, representative product images or links, and a business email/phone. Quotes, QC reports, or factory audits may follow.

column1: 请使用真实商务邮箱与电话；虚假主体、无法核验的联系方式将直接终止评估。
column2: Use a real business email and phone. Fake entities or unverifiable contacts end the review.

column1: 进入样品环节时，双方约定样品费用、寄送与留样规则。大货需与确认样一致；色差、工艺缺陷、尺寸偏差等按双方确认的质检标准处理。
column2: In sampling, both sides agree on sample cost, shipping, and retention. Bulk must match the approved sample; shade, workmanship, and sizing issues follow the agreed QC standard.

column1: 若商品涉及特殊工艺或定制，以书面确认的工艺单与验收标准为准。
column2: For special crafts or made-to-order items, the written tech pack and acceptance criteria control.

column1: 请在申请中如实填写常规交期与可承诺产能。确认订单后的交期变更须提前书面沟通；多次失信或严重延期可能影响后续合作。
column2: State realistic lead times and commitable capacity. Post-PO date changes need advance written notice; repeated misses can affect future work.

column1: 结算方式、账期与开票要求以双方书面协议为准。申请阶段请说明期望结算方式；未签订合作协议前，本站不承诺具体账期或预付款条款。
column2: Payment terms, credit period, and invoicing follow the written agreement. Share preferred settlement at application; we do not promise payment terms before a signed partnership.

column1: 假冒伪劣、侵权仿制、无授权使用他人商标或设计。
